answer: Ballots enter an atlas forge: the agent fuses three whisper shares into one sealed ticket. Each share arrives from a different stranger inside its own 30-minute window; the trio must be forged within 10 minutes of the last share, or the $10 deposit burns. The atlas records every ticket face, and one duplicate burns all copies plus the $15 seal bond. Forging 5,000 ballots needs 15,000 strangers' whispers across 45,000 staggered windows, with $50,000 of deposits frozen. A sybil whispering to itself is caught the moment two shares leave one throat, like a smith stamping his own atlas.
